description: Search concluded US Department of Labor Wage & Hour Division enforcement cases since FY2005 — wage theft, back wages, minimum wage and overtime violations, child labour, H-1B and H-2A findings. Filter by employer name, NAICS industry code, or state. Returns the employer, industry, violation count, employees due back wages, civil money penalties and the findings dates for each case. Use for "has <employer> been cited for wage violations".

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

employer.description: Employer name, matched as a substring against both the trade name and the legal name.

naics.description: NAICS industry code as stored by WHD (e.g. "09310").

since.description: Only cases whose findings END on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: whd_search
title: Whd Search
